messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — ran a cross-model smoke for Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B using kernel-adapter v0.9.3 (dynamic per-op quant selection). saw a p50 regression on Llama when kv-cache warmed; Mistral actually improved.
Maria: config snippet we used:
```json
{
  "quant_profiles": {
    "llama2-13b": "layerwise_fp8_int4",
    "mistral-7b": "fp8-primary",
    "qwen-7b": "int8-hybrid"
  },
  "kernel_adapter": {
    "mode": "dynamic",
    "fallback": "int8_vec",
    "kvcache_share_threshold": 0.7
  },
  "batching": {
    "max_batch": 12,
    "preferred": 4
  },
  "profiling": {
    "sample_count": 2000,
    "prefix_len": 256
  }
}
```
perf-bot: profiling summary (run id 2165432109) — p50 latency (host GPU, 4090-ish):
- Llama2-13B: baseline 98ms -> experiment 160ms (≈+63%)
- Mistral-7B: baseline 54ms -> experiment 48ms (≈-11%)
- Qwen-7B: baseline 72ms -> experiment 75ms (≈+4%)
perf-bot: KV cache metrics: batch=4 warm-hit=0.94, batch=12 warm-hit=0.72, mem-copy/s spikes correlated with fallbacks
Jon: did KV layout change between fp8/int4 kernels? fallback could trigger extra packing/unpacking.
Maria: looks like it — kernel-selector logs show mixed choices per-layer. snippet:
```
[2026-03-10T21:44:12Z] kernel-selector: model=llama2-13b layer=attn_3 chose=fp8_gemm (lat 1.8ms)
[2026-03-10T21:44:12Z] kernel-selector: model=llama2-13b layer=ffn_3 chose=fallback=int8_vec (lat 3.4ms, reason=profile_mismatch)
[2026-03-10T21:44:12Z] kvcache: pack_layout=packed_v1 -> unpack->packed_v2 copies=8 size=12MB
```
Alex: that unpack->pack dance is suspicious. If feedforward uses different packed format, each request with long prefix will do extra memcopies — explains p50 jump for Llama which uses more FFN heavy layers.
Anya: calibration method? layerwise or per-channel? per-channel usually helps int4/4-bit FFNs.
Maria: we used layerwise stats from 2k random prompts (fast, but coarse). not per-channel.
Alex: try forcing per-channel for Llama FFN and also try forcing the int4_fused kernel on FFN (instead of fallback). can we flip kernel_adapter.fallback_policy->prefer_int4 for just that model?
Maria: yes, I'll run two experiments: (A) per-channel calibration + prefer_int4 for FFN, (B) keep layerwise but set kvcache_share_threshold=0.5 to avoid re-packing for larger batches.
perf-bot: micro metrics for experiment run: memcopy/s=312 -> 980 during fallback bursts; cpu memcpy stalls increased, GPU utilization dropped ~6% when copies spiked.
Jon: also consider batching heuristic: with preferred=4 and max=12 we see mixed batch sizes; larger batches amplify repack cost. maybe add hysteresis: promote batch sizes that maintain same packed layout.
Maria: good call. I'll enable batching.hysteresis=0.6 in the next run.
Anya: add a tiny reproducer: single-layer FFN microbench with varying packed layout to measure copy cost. run perf record + nvprof.
Maria: plan: night run with A/B + perf traces; will post flamegraphs and a per-op kernel choice map per model. aims to decide whether to: (1) make selector prefer stable packed formats, (2) extend per-channel calibration for Llama FFNs, or (3) normalize packed layout across kernels to avoid copies.
Alex: if normalizing layout is heavy, prefer (1)+(2) first.
Jon: agree. also add a regression test that runs long-prefix chat workload at batch=12 to catch this in CI.
Maria: noted — adding a perf CI job: nightly/llama2-heavy-kv. will share results tomorrow morning. :coffee:
Anya: thanks — also save the quant profile artifacts and hash them into the run metadata so we can map regressions to exact profiles. :eyes:
Maria: will do. uploading profiles to run 2165432109/artifacts and linking in the follow-up.
Maria: action items assigned: Maria -> re-run + collect traces; Alex -> try prefer_int4 patch; Anya -> microbench reproducer; Jon -> add perf CI test.
perf-bot: ticket created: #INF-4923 "llama2 fp8/int4 fallback memcopy regression" assigned to Maria.
Maria: closing for now, will update thread with results.
